extraction.Name: Oliver Guerue
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded Febr. 5, 1918 by the Bank of Cody
extraction.Buyer: Land was mortgaged to John Guerue by Oliver Guerue and wife January 1, 1918 for $1520.00; on April 3, 1918 Mr. Guerue and his wife conveyed the land to Joseph Valandra for $2000.00, subject to the foregoing mortgage
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612683 issued; northeast quarter of section 14, township 40, range 26; receipt for patent signed but not dated; document dated Rosebud, S. Dak., June 1929
